# port_scorecard_groups (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all scorecard groups in the organization. This mirrors the Port API `GET /v1/scorecard-groups` endpoint.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) All scorecard groups returned by the Port API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source result.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `identifier` (String) The scorecard group identifier.
- `title` (String) The scorecard group title.
